content: MK reports that in the author's own hierarchies (levels three and four in the R. Shaqq-i Qamar, level three in the R. Madarij Afham al-Afwaj), Farabi and Suhravardi fall far short of universal knowledge; MK says Ṭabāṭabāʾī's ranking of Ibn Turka alongside them is therefore an injustice to him.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar; R. Madarij Afham al-Afwaj
